import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]

# Create figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Top products by total revenue (bar chart)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars1 = axes[0, 0].bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values, color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 10 Products by Total Revenue', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars1:
    height = bar.get_height()
    axes[0, 0].text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
                   f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group and takeaway status (stacked bar chart)
age_takeaway = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'}))
age_takeaway.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[0, 1], color=['#2E86AB', '#A23B72'])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group and Service Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Service Type')

# 3. Price distribution by product size (boxplot)
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='size', y='price', order=size_order, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Price Distribution by Product Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)

# 4. Payment method preference by age group (heatmap)
payment_age = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['payment_method'], normalize='index') * 100
sns.heatmap(payment_age, annot=True, fmt='.1f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=axes[1, 1], cbar_kws={'label': 'Percentage (%)'})
axes[1, 1].set_title('Payment Method Preference by Age Group (%)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
